selection_rule: Use the shortest target in the frozen expanded five-residue stratum; do not replace the case after observing outcomes.
modes: native conditioning with publication-time rigid synchronization and exact fixed-atom projection
native conditioning plus post-update per-step rigid synchronization and exact fixed-atom reinjection
per-step reinjection plus generated-only OpenMM CPU boundary refinement
stop_rules: Stop if the callback count differs from 500.
Stop if callback output changes tensor shape, device, or dtype.
Stop if any fixed heavy atom is not exactly restored after projection.
Record geometry validation failures without changing sampling or refinement parameters.
